lyrics.en: This is wrong—I don't care anymore

lyrics.romaji: Uh Ikenai n Da Do You Know?
lyrics.en: Uh, this is wrong—do you know?
lyrics.zh: uh，這樣不行 do you know？

lyrics.ja: 行けないんだ　もう知らない
lyrics.en: I can't go—I don't care anymore

lyrics.ja: 好き？　と思わせて素気なく...
lyrics.en: Making me think you like me, then acting cold...
lyrics.zh: 讓我以為你喜歡我，卻又冷淡以待……

lyrics.ja: からかわれてるよ
lyrics.en: You're teasing me

lyrics.ja: もう知らない(怒)
lyrics.en: I don't care anymore (angry)

lyrics.ja: マニュアル通りのカケヒキしてないでさ

lyrics.en: Don't play by-the-book love games

lyrics.ja: こっち向いてその気になってよ
lyrics.romaji: Kocchi Muite Sono Ki ni Natte yo
lyrics.en: Face this way and fall for me already

lyrics.ja: ひどいじゃない　ずるいじゃない
lyrics.romaji: Hidoi ja Nai Zurui ja Nai
lyrics.en: Isn't that cruel? Isn't that unfair?
lyrics.zh: 不是很過分嗎？不是很狡猾嗎？

lyrics.ja: かなり好きなんだけど
lyrics.romaji: Kanari Suki na n Da kedo
lyrics.en: I like you quite a lot, you know

lyrics.ja: こっちから言わせないで Ah
lyrics.en: Don't make me be the one to say it—ah
lyrics.zh: 別讓我先說出口啊 Ah

lyrics.ja: いけないんだ　いけないんだ　ダメって
lyrics.romaji: Ikenai n Da Ikenai n Da Dame tte
lyrics.en: This is wrong, this is wrong—you say it's no good
lyrics.zh: 不行啦、不行啦，說什麼不可以

lyrics.ja: もう！わかってる！？わかってない！？
lyrics.en: Geez! Do you get it!? You don't get it!?

lyrics.ja: 多分君のせいだよ
lyrics.romaji: Tabun Kimi no Sei Da yo
lyrics.en: It's probably your fault

lyrics.ja: 意地悪いのも素直じゃないのも　あ～あ
lyrics.romaji: Ijiwarui no mo Sunao ja Nai no mo Aa
lyrics.en: Both your mean streak and your stubbornness—ah~ah
lyrics.zh: 不管是壞心眼還是不坦率，啊～啊

lyrics.ja: 君のせいだ
lyrics.en: It's your fault

lyrics.en: Don't make me misunderstand

lyrics.ja: 現状維持でいいとか思ってないよね？

lyrics.en: You don't think keeping the status quo is fine, right?
lyrics.zh: 你不會覺得維持現狀就好吧？

lyrics.ja: それとも全く関心ないの？
lyrics.romaji: Sore tomo Mattaku Kanshin Nai no?
lyrics.en: Or do you have no interest at all?

lyrics.en: "Do that! Do this!"
